notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=wKq6LYGwCCg;full][/previewyoutube]

We are excited to announce that Trouble Comes Twice releases July 14th here on STEAM!

It's been a long journey to get here, but we couldn't be more grateful for the support and patience you all have shown us. Now, it's just a little while left until you will get to enjoy the game yourselves.

While you wait, remember you can always keep an eye on our Twitter for regular updates.

See you on July 14!
